Bộ đề thi thử **AB-100 Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect** — 114 câu, có đáp án và giải thích tiếng Việt. Chọn đáp án → **Kiểm tra** để xem đúng/sai và lời giải. Tiến độ được lưu trong trình duyệt.

::: {#ab100-app}
Đang tải ngân hàng câu hỏi…
:::

```{=html}
<style>
#ab100-app { --ok:#1a7f37; --no:#cf222e; --accent:#2563eb; --line:#e5e7eb; --muted:#6b7280; --bg-soft:#f6f8fa; margin-top:1rem; }
#ab100-app *{box-sizing:border-box}
.ab-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:1rem}
.ab-bar select,.ab-bar button{font:inherit;padding:.4rem .7rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.45rem;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}
.ab-bar button:hover{background:var(--bg-soft)}
.ab-bar .primary{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.ab-stats{display:flex;gap:1.2rem;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin-left:auto}
.ab-stats b{color:#111}
.ab-progress{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:1rem}
.ab-progress>i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--accent);transition:width .3s}
.ab-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 220px;gap:1.5rem}
@media(max-width:820px){.ab-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ab-map-wrap{order:-1}}
.ab-map{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(30px,1fr));gap:4px}
.ab-map button{aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;background:#fff;font-size:.72rem;cursor:pointer;padding:0;color:#111}
.ab-map button.cur{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px;font-weight:700}
.ab-map button.ok{background:#dafbe1;border-color:#a6e9b9}
.ab-map button.no{background:#ffe3e3;border-color:#ffb3b3}
.ab-map button.seen{background:var(--bg-soft)}
.ab-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.7rem;padding:1.2rem 1.3rem;background:#fff}
.ab-qnum{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em}
.ab-stem{margin:.5rem 0 1rem;line-height:1.6}
.ab-stem p{margin:.5rem 0}
.ab-stem h4.ab-h{font-size:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);margin:1rem 0 .35rem;font-weight:700}
.ab-stem ul{margin:.4rem 0 .6rem;padding-left:1.2rem}
.ab-stem li{margin:.25rem 0}
.ab-stem .ab-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;background:var(--bg-soft);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.3rem;padding:.05rem .4rem;color:var(--muted);vertical-align:.08em}
.ab-stem.cs{max-height:260px;overflow:auto;padding:.9rem 1rem;background:var(--bg-soft);border-radius:.5rem;font-size:.92rem}
.ab-stem.cs.expanded{max-height:none}
.ab-expand{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;padding:.2rem 0;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.ab-opts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem}
.ab-opt{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:flex-start;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:.5rem;padding:.6rem .8rem;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.5}
.ab-opt:hover{border-color:#c8ccd2;background:#fafbfc}
.ab-opt.sel{border-color:var(--accent);background:#eef4ff}
.ab-opt .mk{flex:0 0 1.4rem;height:1.4rem;border:1px solid #c8ccd2;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.ab-opt.sel .mk{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.ab-card.checked .ab-opt{cursor:default}
.ab-card.checked .ab-opt.correct{border-color:var(--ok);background:#eafaef}
.ab-card.checked .ab-opt.correct .mk{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok);color:#fff}
.ab-card.checked .ab-opt.wrong{border-color:var(--no);background:#fdeef0}
.ab-card.checked .ab-opt.wrong .mk{background:var(--no);border-color:var(--no);color:#fff}
.ab-actions{display:flex;gap:.6rem;margin-top:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ab-verdict{margin-top:1rem;font-weight:700}
.ab-verdict.ok{color:var(--ok)} .ab-verdict.no{color:var(--no)}
.ab-expl{margin-top:.8rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:.9rem;font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.6}
.ab-expl h4{font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);margin:.9rem 0 .3rem}
.ab-expl h4:first-child{margin-top:0}
.ab-hint{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:.5rem}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
 #ab100-app{--line:#30363d;--muted:#8b949e;--bg-soft:#161b22}
 #ab100-app .ab-card,#ab100-app .ab-bar select,#ab100-app .ab-bar button,#ab100-app .ab-map button{background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3}
 #ab100-app .ab-opt{background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3}
 #ab100-app .ab-opt.sel{background:#132a4d}
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  const root=document.getElementById('ab100-app');
  const KEY='ab100-practice-v1';
  let BANK=[], view=[], idx=0, mode='all', state={};

  function load(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY))||{}}catch(e){return {}}}
  function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}

  fetch('ab-100-bank.json').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>{BANK=d; state=load(); boot();})
    .catch(e=>{root.innerHTML='<p style="color:#cf222e">Không tải được ngân hàng câu hỏi (ab-100-bank.json). Thử mở trang qua <code>quarto preview</code> hoặc bản đã publish.</p>';});

  function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.random()*(i+1)|0;[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}

  function buildView(){
    let ids;
    if(mode==='all') ids=BANK.map(q=>q.id);
    else if(mode==='set1') ids=BANK.filter(q=>q.id<=60).map(q=>q.id);
    else if(mode==='set2') ids=BANK.filter(q=>q.id>60).map(q=>q.id);
    else if(mode==='exam') ids=shuffle(BANK.map(q=>q.id)).slice(0,60);
    else if(mode==='wrong') ids=BANK.filter(q=>state[q.id]&&state[q.id].correct===false).map(q=>q.id);
    view=ids.map(id=>BANK.find(q=>q.id===id));
    if(root.dataset.shuffle==='1') shuffle(view);
    idx=0;
  }

  function boot(){
    root.innerHTML=`
      <div class="ab-bar">
        <select id="ab-mode">
          <option value="all">Toàn bộ 114 câu</option>
          <option value="exam">Ngẫu nhiên 60 (mô phỏng thi)</option>
          <option value="set1">Bộ 1 · câu 1–60</option>
          <option value="set2">Bộ 2 · câu 61–114</option>
          <option value="wrong">Chỉ câu đã làm sai</option>
        </select>
        <button id="ab-shuffle">Xáo trộn: tắt</button>
        <button id="ab-reset">Làm lại</button>
        <div class="ab-stats">
          <span>Đúng <b id="ab-nok">0</b></span>
          <span>Sai <b id="ab-nno">0</b></span>
          <span>Đã làm <b id="ab-ndone">0</b>/<b id="ab-ntot">0</b></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ab-progress"><i id="ab-pbar"></i></div>
      <div class="ab-layout">
        <div id="ab-main"></div>
        <div class="ab-map-wrap"><div class="ab-map" id="ab-map"></div></div>
      </div>`;
    root.dataset.shuffle='0';
    document.getElementById('ab-mode').onchange=e=>{mode=e.target.value;buildView();render()};
    document.getElementById('ab-shuffle').onclick=e=>{root.dataset.shuffle=root.dataset.shuffle==='1'?'0':'1';e.target.textContent='Xáo trộn: '+(root.dataset.shuffle==='1'?'bật':'tắt');buildView();render()};
    document.getElementById('ab-reset').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Xoá toàn bộ tiến độ đã lưu?')){state={};save();buildView();render()}};
    document.addEventListener('keydown',onkey);
    buildView();render();
  }

  function onkey(e){
    if(!view.length) return;
    if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){go(-1)}
    else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){go(1)}
    else if(e.key==='Enter'){const b=document.getElementById('ab-check');if(b)b.click()}
    else if(/^[1-9]$/.test(e.key)){const q=view[idx];const n=+e.key-1;if(q&&n<q.options.length&&!(state[q.id]&&state[q.id].checked))toggle(q,n)}
  }
  function go(d){idx=Math.max(0,Math.min(view.length-1,idx+d));render()}

  function toggle(q,n){
    const s=state[q.id]||(state[q.id]={picked:[],checked:false});
    if(s.checked) return;
    const want=q.correct.length;
    const i=s.picked.indexOf(n);
    if(i>=0) s.picked.splice(i,1);
    else{ if(want===1) s.picked=[n]; else if(s.picked.length<want) s.picked.push(n); else s.picked=[...s.picked.slice(1),n]; }
    save();render();
  }
  function check(q){
    const s=state[q.id]; if(!s||!s.picked.length) return;
    s.checked=true;
    s.correct = s.picked.length===q.correct.length && s.picked.every(p=>q.correct.includes(p));
    save();render();
  }

  function stats(){
    let ok=0,no=0,done=0;
    view.forEach(q=>{const s=state[q.id];if(s&&s.checked){done++;s.correct?ok++:no++}});
    document.getElementById('ab-nok').textContent=ok;
    document.getElementById('ab-nno').textContent=no;
    document.getElementById('ab-ndone').textContent=done;
    document.getElementById('ab-ntot').textContent=view.length;
    document.getElementById('ab-pbar').style.width=(view.length?done/view.length*100:0)+'%';
  }
  function renderMap(){
    const m=document.getElementById('ab-map');m.innerHTML='';
    view.forEach((q,i)=>{
      const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=q.id;
      const s=state[q.id];
      if(i===idx)b.classList.add('cur');
      if(s&&s.checked)b.classList.add(s.correct?'ok':'no');
      else if(s&&s.picked.length)b.classList.add('seen');
      b.onclick=()=>{idx=i;render()};
      m.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  function esc(t){const d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=t;return d.innerHTML}
  function inl(t){return esc(t).replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<span class="ab-tag">$1</span>').replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/(?<!\*)\*([^*\n]+)\*(?!\*)/g,'<em>$1</em>')}
  function mdStem(src){
    const lines=src.split('\n'); let html='',buf=[],list=[];
    const flushP=()=>{if(buf.length){html+='<p>'+buf.join(' ')+'</p>';buf=[]}};
    const flushL=()=>{if(list.length){html+='<ul>'+list.map(x=>'<li>'+x+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>';list=[]}};
    for(let ln of lines){
      const t=ln.trim();
      if(!t){flushP();flushL();continue}
      if(t.startsWith('### ')){flushP();flushL();html+='<h4 class="ab-h">'+inl(t.slice(4))+'</h4>';continue}
      if(t.startsWith('- ')){flushP();list.push(inl(t.slice(2)));continue}
      flushL();buf.push(inl(t));
    }
    flushP();flushL();return html;
  }

  function render(){
    if(!view.length){document.getElementById('ab-main').innerHTML='<div class="ab-card">Không có câu nào trong chế độ này.</div>';renderMap();stats();return}
    const q=view[idx];
    const s=state[q.id]||{picked:[],checked:false};
    const isCS=q.stem.length>900;
    const main=document.getElementById('ab-main');
    let h=`<div class="ab-card${s.checked?' checked':''}">
      <div class="ab-qnum">CÂU ${q.id} / 114 · ${idx+1} trong ${view.length}${q.correct.length>1?' · chọn '+q.correct.length+' đáp án':''}</div>
      <div class="ab-stem${isCS?' cs':''}" id="ab-stem">${mdStem(q.stem)}</div>`;
    if(isCS) h+=`<button class="ab-expand" id="ab-exp">Mở rộng / thu gọn đề</button>`;
    h+=`<div class="ab-opts">`;
    q.options.forEach((o,n)=>{
      let cls='ab-opt';
      if(s.picked.includes(n))cls+=' sel';
      if(s.checked){ if(q.correct.includes(n))cls+=' correct'; else if(s.picked.includes(n))cls+=' wrong'; }
      h+=`<div class="${cls}" data-n="${n}"><span class="mk">${'ABCDEFGH'[n]}</span><span>${esc(o)}</span></div>`;
    });
    h+=`</div>`;
    h+=`<div class="ab-actions">
      <button ${idx===0?'disabled':''} id="ab-prev">← Trước</button>`;
    if(!s.checked) h+=`<button class="primary" id="ab-check" ${s.picked.length?'':'disabled'}>Kiểm tra</button>`;
    h+=`<button ${idx===view.length-1?'disabled':''} id="ab-next">Sau →</button></div>`;
    if(s.checked){
      h+=`<div class="ab-verdict ${s.correct?'ok':'no'}">${s.correct?'✓ Chính xác':'✗ Chưa đúng'} — đáp án: ${q.correct.map(i=>'ABCDEFGH'[i]).join(', ')}</div>`;
      h+=`<div class="ab-expl">`;
      q.sections.forEach(sec=>{h+=`<h4>${esc(sec.h)}</h4><div>${esc(sec.t)}</div>`});
      h+=`</div>`;
    } else {
      h+=`<div class="ab-hint">Phím tắt: 1–${q.options.length} chọn · Enter kiểm tra · ← → chuyển câu</div>`;
    }
    h+=`</div>`;
    main.innerHTML=h;
    main.querySelectorAll('.ab-opt').forEach(el=>el.onclick=()=>toggle(q,+el.dataset.n));
    const pv=document.getElementById('ab-prev');if(pv)pv.onclick=()=>go(-1);
    const nx=document.getElementById('ab-next');if(nx)nx.onclick=()=>go(1);
    const ck=document.getElementById('ab-check');if(ck)ck.onclick=()=>check(q);
    const ex=document.getElementById('ab-exp');if(ex)ex.onclick=()=>document.getElementById('ab-stem').classList.toggle('expanded');
    renderMap();stats();
  }
})();
</script>
```
